about_the_game:
"Dracs After Dusk" is an arcade, top-down shooter. Blast through bloodsuckers as the sharp shootin’ sheriff of a wild west town. Duke it out with the deadliest bosses, claim their powerful weapons from the Armory and tasty food consumables from the Pantry to fuel your leaderboard topping run. Welcome to an old school quarter muncher but luckily you have unlimited credits!

Survive waves of vampires 

  • Shoot down waves of enemy vampires using your trusty six-shooter revolver.

  • Dosido your way around tight quarters to avoid your last drop of blood being drained.

  • Build turrets to cover gaps in your reload time.

Duke it out with deadly bosses

  • Challenging multiphase boss battles will test your resilience & ability to execute under pressure.

  • Unique boss battles await you at the Armory, Diner, & Casino.

  • Each Big Baddie encounter features unique handcrafted playful pixel art animations.

Earn upgraded items & consumables 

  • Defeat the Armory boss to claim new powerful weapons, such as the shotgun, sniper rifle, and SMG.

  • Choose your boss rush order to customize your upgrade path.

  • Drop by the soul split shop to prevent 1 hit death.

Climb the Leaderboards

  • Relive the golden age arcade glory days to claim the ultimate reward of topping the leaderboard. 

  • The global leaderboard pits you against the world's sharpest shooters. 

  • Best in week leaderboard offers a fresh opportunity for ultimate bragging rights.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 or AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or NVIDIA GeForce GT 630 or AMD Radeon HD 5570
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 360
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
